value.syntax: # [doc = " Public settlement refusal; a fault is retained for the run."] # [doc = " (´def:wallet:settlement-refusal´)"] # [derive (Clone , Copy , Debug , Eq , PartialEq)] pub enum SettlementRefusal { # [doc = " A chain position the decision needs was not read; nothing is guessed."] Unavailable { # [doc = " Height whose active-chain hash is absent."] height : u64 , } , # [doc = " Evidence is not on the observed chain at its claimed height."] Stale { # [doc = " Display-order transaction identifier."] transaction : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Output index."] output : u32 , } , # [doc = " One outpoint was reported with different locators or amounts."] Alias { # [doc = " Display-order transaction identifier."] transaction : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Output index."] output : u32 , } , # [doc = " The pinned total does not fit the amount type."] Overflow , # [doc = " The observed chain no longer holds the pinned floor: a realization fault for the run."] # [doc = " Pinned amounts are retained unchanged and every later observation returns this fault."] Fault { # [doc = " Pinned floor height the observed chain conflicts with."] height : u64 , # [doc = " Retained pinned total, never edited downward."] retained : u64 , } , }
